description:
UNDER OFFER!!!!
APP Kirrane Auctioneering are delighted to offer to the market this splendid three bedroom property.  Located adjacent to the new Primary Care Centre and within walking distance of all amenities Ballyhaunis town has to offer including shops, service providers, National and Secondary Schools,  bus and train service.  The property has been vacant for in excess of two years therefore will qualify for the vacant homes grants, SEAI insulation upgrade grant and the windows and doors grants.

The property accommodation offers a bright welcoming entrance hallway, carpet staircase to sleeping accommodation.  Sitting room with fireplace and front aspect window.  Kitchen to the rear of the property with rear access and separate dining area.  Upstairs offers three double bedrooms with built in wardrobes, carpet flooring and a spacious family sized bathroom with electric shower installed.

Outside offers a charming front garden.  A patio and garden space to the rear with a sizable garage.  This is ideal for outdoor storage, but holds potential to convert to stand alone living accommodation.  

The location of the property is ideal with Ballyhaunis a town that offers a large range of employment opportunities including; Homecare Medical, PBod, Dawn Meats, Western Brand, Cashel Engineering, Major Equipment to mention just a few.  A short drive to Ireland West Airport, Knock Shrine, a selection of fishing lakes, scenic walks and golf courses.  Only an hour's drive to Galway, Sligo, Athlone or Westport makes this an ideal location for commuting families and students. 

For further information or to arrange viewing please make contact with the Sole Selling Agents APP Kirrane Auctioneering where everything we touch turns to SOLD.
